picks.why: nVent sells rack-level cooling and electrical enclosures, with revenue up 53%, a 19% operating margin and an AMD cooling deal, at 18.8x forward earnings and 31% below its high. It sits where power and cooling limit the build-out, and the watchlist has no grid or cooling name.
picks.risk: A funding-driven cut to data-centre capex would hit orders before the physical constraint helps.

picks.why: HPE trades at 11.8x forward earnings with a 6% free cash flow yield and 34% revenue growth, the best cash-flow price on the shortlist and well above the 2% typical of its peers. It gives AI demand exposure without neocloud credit risk.
picks.risk: A 13% operating margin could compress if AI server mix grows and customers lose financing.
